files.s: In this file we formalize the Lagrange multipliers method of solving conditional extremum problems: if a function `φ` has a local extremum at `x₀` on the set `f ⁻¹' {f x₀}`, `f x = (f₀ x, ..., fₙ₋₁ x)`, then the differentials of `fₖ` and `φ` are linearly dependent.
